card.name: The word incidence in adverse-event reporting
card.fires_on: The word "incidence" (or its first part, "Inc" before "idence") when a label sentence is about to give a rate of an adverse reaction, usually after "the" or "higher".

modes.label: Incidence after the/higher
modes.description: The word incidence starts a statement about how often an adverse reaction occurred, followed by "of" or "was" and a percentage.
modes.example: The<< incidence>> of hepatic failure in the pancreatic cancer

modes.label: Split word in a heading
modes.description: The pole fires inside a split word in a table or section heading, such as Inc-idence or Abs-orption.
modes.example: Table 1 Inc<<idence>> of Congestive Heart Failure in Ad
